handoff.text: REVIEW-4.md. 1) should-fix: src/App.tsx:100-108 unsavedDocumentSettings restates Writer's fallbacks (src/Writer.tsx:339-346 size 14/line 1.5/margin, :1131 indent) as separate literals; values match today but can drift. Fix: export one constant (e.g. editorFallbackSettings in src/research/types.ts) and have Writer read documentSettings ?? it and App merge onto it. 2) medium, coordinator/owner decision, not a worker defect: on a no-settings project the Page setup toggle now flips the EXPORT (Times New Roman 12 double+indent -> Sans 14 1.5 no indent; probed), since export merges onto defaultDocumentSettings (src/export/document.ts:91); the Export panel checkbox (App.tsx:2635) and Bibliography (App.tsx:2667) still flip the editor. Rest fine: splittableMarks filter, label, System font box, Writer HS2/5/7/8 edits all present, with-settings toggle changes only pageNumbers, writes via mutate.

review.note: REVIEW-5.md. Every documentSettings reader in src grepped and resolves via editorSettings/exportSettings or per-key fallback; probes: no-settings/{} export byte-identical (docx xml, pdf content streams, md, txt) to full defaults; partials never undefined/NaN; validate+archive round-trip ok; tsc clean; export tests untouched and green. Low: changedSettings stores keys vs current effective (not defaults) and keys are sticky (HS10.md wording wrong); no-settings editor/Export-panel look mismatch predates batch (owner decision); template from partial gets export defaults; hs10 spec covers only page-number toggle.
